description-meta: "The largest three-day total since October 1 is ranked against each 1991-2020 reference water year through the same calendar date. ::: {.product-interpretation}
The largest three-day total since October 1 is ranked against each 1991-2020 reference water year through the same calendar date. High ranks identify unusually large events for this point in the year; only complete within-year windows count, February 29 uses interpolated references, and tied zeros can be near normal in a normally dry period.
:::
